story.theme: Radha hears Krishna's flute in Vrindavan and follows its sound to a quiet meeting beside the Yamuna.
story_arc: A mysterious flute begins beside the Yamuna.
The music seems to change the stillness of Vrindavan.
Radha hears the flute and recognizes its call.
She follows the sound through the trees.
She discovers Krishna beside the Yamuna.
They meet through a quiet exchanged glance.
The flute falls silent and the story ends in peaceful stillness.
story.visual_rule: Every shot must feel like a frame from one coherent stylized 3D animated film. Reference images are the source of truth for character identity, body and appearance; prompts control only the story scene, action, camera and composition.
story.storytelling_rule: Show the story through visible actions, environment, eyelines, movement and composition. Narration must support the visuals rather than explain what the viewer can already see.
story.ending: Hold on Radha and Krishna together beside the Yamuna while the peacock and environment complete the frame. Let the final shot breathe before cutting to black.
continuity_rules: Reuse the same character reference assets throughout the movie.
Treat clear face-and-body character references as authoritative; do not verbally redesign the characters.
For every multi-character shot, Reference 1 is Krishna and Reference 2 is Radha.
Never merge or transfer identity between Krishna and Radha.
Do not turn Krishna into a muscular superhero or bodybuilder.
Keep scene images wide 16:9 at source stage.
Every shot must advance the story or deepen the emotional beat.
Do not pad duration with repetitive shots.

edit.pacing: Use 2-3 second Wan clips as cinematic building blocks. Group several related micro-shots into each story beat so the edit feels like a movie rather than a rapid slideshow.
edit.transition_style: mostly clean cuts and occasional gentle dissolves only where emotionally appropriate
edit.subtitles: optional Hindi subtitles matching the Hindi voiceover exactly
edit.crop_note: Source images and scenes are 16:9. Preserve faces and key action when creating the final 9:16 social crop.
